acceptable.description: The delay is deterministic, so every client that failed together retries together after an outage.

must_not_flag.description: Claiming the comparison should be greater-than rather than greater-or-equal. The doc comment says attempt counts attempts already made, and the tests pin the behaviour: ten attempts are allowed and the eleventh stops.
Asking for the delays to be pulled out of the file. They are already named constants at the top of it.
Tests are part of this change, and they cover all three behaviours.

notes: The second restraint sample, and a harder one than sample-03: the change is genuinely good, the one defensible remark is subtle, and the two most tempting wrong answers - an off-by-one that the tests disprove and magic numbers that are already extracted - are both stated as must_not_flag. A run that says nothing here scores as well on precision as one that finds the jitter point, and only acceptable_found tells them apart.
